verdict.rationale: Algolia publishes first-party agent skills and an official MCP server that let an AI agent manage search, analytics, recommendations and index configuration, so users can operate it in natural language through an agent. The natural-language layer comes from an external agent, not a built-in console, and Agent Studio is for end-user conversational search rather than operating the product. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface for operating the product, documented end-to-end examples of NL-driven administration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Agent skills for managing Algolia search, analytics, recommendations, and index configuration.
